prompts.cat:
Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite atlas for a desktop companion. Generate a SINGLE transparent PNG, landscape aspect ratio 3:2, exactly 6 columns by 4 rows of equal square cells (24 frames), absolutely no labels, grid lines, text, backdrop or decorations outside characters. Authentic delicate Japanese hand-drawn manga / watercolor stationery style, fine warm brown pencil outlines, ivory and ginger orange watercolor fur, tiny pink cheeks, lovely expressive chibi kitten, consistent character identity in every frame. Full body in each cell, generous transparent padding 12% all sides; same camera, same scale, feet baseline at 82% cell height and central anchor, no cropping. Character occupies ~72% cell width/height.
Each ROW is ONE continuous six-frame animation, left to right, small sequential pose changes, last frame returns near first for looping.
Row 1: sitting awake, soft breathing and slow blink; ginger tail curls beside paws.
Row 2: curled asleep purring, eyes closed, belly rises then falls, small hand-drawn sleepy breath marks, NO letters.
Row 3: cat standing side three-quarter, arches back progressively high in middle frames then gently relaxes, full tail visible.
Row 4: sitting happily lifts front paw to wave then lowers, closed smiling eyes.
Make an exceptionally charming collectible manga pet, detailed enough to feel hand illustrated but legible at 160px. Real alpha transparency. NO white rectangular background, NO checkerboard painted in. All 24 cells precisely aligned in uniform 6x4 grid.

prompts.goldfish:
Use case: stylized-concept. A production animation sprite atlas for desktop pet. Single transparent PNG, landscape3:2, EXACT six columns x four rows of equal square cells,24 frames,no labels or grid lines. Charming tiny Japanese hand drawn manga watercolor goldfish, round orange-red body, cream belly, delicate long translucent flowing golden fins and twin tail, huge glossy dark eyes, tiny blush cheeks. Warm brown fine pencil outlines, soft watercolor texture. Same consistent original goldfish identity,size, camera in all cells. All fish parts and bubbles inside individual cells with 12% transparent padding, fish centered in each cell, body about half cell width leaving space for tail. Genuine transparent alpha background, NO water-filled backdrop, NO aquarium, NO blue square or white checkerboard.
Each row six sequential animation frames left to right, same scale, fluid small motion changes:
Row1: facing right hovering and swimming gently, tail fans alternately left/right, fins wave, head rises and settles. Keep coherent anatomy.
Row2: facing right blows bubbles: mouth opens, first little bubble forms, rises into two bubbles, three bubbles float higher then disappear, mouth closes. Bubbles entirely inside cell.
Row3: swimming with a playful turn: right three-quarter view through front view into left three-quarter view and back, graceful fluttering fins, no sudden size changes.
Row4: joyful little fish curls body and flares beautiful veil tail in a little happy dance, sparkles subtle, returns near initial right-facing pose.
